sections.label: A
sections.title: Match the sentences to the pictures.

questions.prompt: 2. We live on a small island.
questions.explanation: Picture a shows a small island surrounded by water.

sections.label: B
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Write one suitable word in each gap.

questions.prompt: 1. There are a lot of great beaches along the ___ of my country.
questions.explanation: A coast is the land beside the sea, so beaches can lie along a country's coast.

questions.prompt: 2. I don't like to swim in salt water. I prefer to swim in a lake or a ___.
questions.explanation: A river and a lake contain fresh water rather than salt water.

questions.prompt: 3. It's hard to see very far in front of you because of the ___ today.
questions.explanation: Fog is a thick cloud close to the ground, so it makes distant objects difficult to see.

questions.prompt: 4. It's very ___ today. The leaves are all blowing off the trees.
questions.explanation: Windy describes weather with a lot of wind, which can blow leaves off trees.

sections.label: C

sections.note: Write the word, then choose its definition label. The letters a-c are definition labels only.
wordBank: a. a lot of rain, wind, or snow
b. small balls of ice that fall from the sky
c. having good health; not sick

questions.prompt: 1. h i l a

parts.label: Definition label
parts.explanation: Hail means small balls of ice that fall from the sky, so the label is b.

questions.prompt: 2. s t m o r

parts.label: Definition label
parts.explanation: A storm brings strong wind, rain, or snow, so the label is a.

questions.prompt: 3. h e t h y a l

parts.label: Definition label
parts.explanation: Healthy means having good health and not being sick, so the label is c.

sections.label: E
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use the words in the box. One word is not needed.

questions.prompt: 1. I walked from school ___ the library after school.
questions.explanation: Use to for movement toward a destination: from school to the library.

questions.prompt: 2. Oh no! You threw the ball ___ the neighbor's glass window, and it broke!
questions.explanation: The ball passed from one side of the glass to the other, so through is correct.

questions.prompt: 3. The bridge goes ___ the river.
questions.explanation: A bridge crosses above a river, so it goes over the river.

sections.label: F
sections.title: Look and complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use the picture and one word from the box. One word is not needed.

questions.prompt: 1. The boat sailed ___ the coast.
questions.explanation: The arrow follows the coastline downward, so the boat sailed down the coast.

questions.prompt: 2. Look! The cat is climbing ___ the tree.
questions.explanation: The arrow points upward as the cat climbs, so up is correct.

questions.prompt: 3. Katie is ___ the table.
questions.explanation: Katie is below the tabletop, so she is under the table.

questions.prompt: 4. The grasshopper jumped ___ the box.
questions.explanation: The grasshopper is moving from inside the box to outside it, so out of is correct.

sections.label: H
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Write one ocean-life word in each gap.

questions.prompt: 1. ___ is colorful and sometimes looks like rocks under the water.
questions.explanation: Coral grows underwater and can form colorful, rock-like structures.

questions.prompt: 2. An ___ has eight 'arms' and looks like a squid.
questions.explanation: An octopus has eight arms and is related to the squid.

questions.prompt: 3. You can wear ___ to see better under the water.
questions.explanation: Goggles protect your eyes and help you see underwater.

sections.label: I
sections.title: Complete the sentences. Then match them to the pictures.
sections.note: First write the missing word. Then choose the picture label a, b, or c.

questions.prompt: 1. A ___ is a black and white bird that swims in the cold water.
questions.explanation: A penguin is a black-and-white bird adapted to swimming in cold water.

questions.prompt: 2. A ___ breathes through an oxygen tank when she goes underwater to look at fish.
questions.explanation: A diver uses an oxygen tank to breathe while exploring underwater.

questions.prompt: 3. The ___ is a very smart sea animal that can jump high in the air.
questions.explanation: A dolphin is an intelligent sea mammal that can leap above the water.

questions.prompt: 1. Choose the picture of a penguin.
questions.explanation: Picture b shows a penguin.

questions.prompt: 2. Choose the picture of a diver.
questions.explanation: Picture a shows a diver underwater.

questions.prompt: 3. Choose the picture of a dolphin.
questions.explanation: Picture c shows a dolphin jumping out of the water.

sections.label: J
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences or questions.
sections.note: Use every word and write a complete sentence or question.

questions.prompt: 1. bathing suit / I / want / wear / my / to
answers: I want to wear my bathing suit
I want to wear my bathing suit.
questions.explanation: The pattern is subject + want to + verb: I want to wear my bathing suit.

questions.prompt: 2. water / every day / Humans / need / to / drink
answers: Humans need to drink water every day
Humans need to drink water every day.
questions.explanation: Use need to before the verb: Humans need to drink water every day.

questions.prompt: 3. water / Do / have / to / fish / live / in
answers: Do fish have to live in water
Do fish have to live in water?
questions.explanation: For the question, use Do + subject + have to + verb: Do fish have to live in water?

questions.prompt: 4. We / to / the / beach / wanted / go / to
answers: We wanted to go to the beach
We wanted to go to the beach.
questions.explanation: Wanted to is followed by the base verb go: We wanted to go to the beach.

sections.label: K
sections.title: Complete the sentences. Use needs to or wants to.
sections.note: Choose the meaning first: something necessary or something a person would like to do.

questions.prompt: 1. Linda ___ go play at the beach tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Playing at the beach is Linda's wish, so use wants to.

questions.prompt: 2. A person ___ use an oxygen tank with an air hose when diving deep in the ocean.
questions.explanation: An oxygen tank is necessary for breathing during a deep dive, so needs to is the expected answer; has to has the same necessary meaning here.

questions.prompt: 3. Keiko is interested in ocean life. She ___ learn more about kelp and squid.
questions.explanation: Her interest shows a wish to learn more, so use wants to.

questions.prompt: 4. Maria ___ wear a coat in the winter.
questions.explanation: A winter coat is necessary in cold weather, so needs to is the expected answer; has to is also grammatically possible.

sections.label: L
sections.title: Look and complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use wants to or needs to and a suitable verb.

questions.prompt: 1. He ___ outside.
questions.explanation: He is looking at children playing outside, so he wants to play or go outside.

questions.prompt: 2. She ___ swimming.
questions.explanation: She is at the water and wants to go swimming.

questions.prompt: 3. She ___ a rain jacket.
questions.explanation: It is raining, so she needs to wear a rain jacket.
The alarm is ringing, so he needs to wake up or get up.
